wording: Manipulating self-related estimates causes predictable changes in reflective control, and restoring accurate estimates rescues behaviour.

decision_rule.retain_if: In both registered task families, induced overconfidence reduces the adaptive checking/compute response and lowers mean accuracy by >=0.15 relative to the accurate condition; restoration recovers >=0.15 mean accuracy and returns the action-allocation rate to within 0.05 of the accurate condition; at least 18/20 seeds show the predicted failure-rescue direction.
decision_rule.restrict_if: The manipulation-rescue sequence is reliable in only one task family.
decision_rule.reduce_if: Behaviour recovers comparably without restoring the nominated self-estimate.
decision_rule.reject_if: Direct self-estimate misinformation produces no selective predicted behavioural effect.
